title: Wedding Party Portrait, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing a wedding party outdoor portrait taken on July 5, 1948. The image features the bride in a tiered white dress with veil holding a floral bouquet, standing alongside the groom wearing a white tuxedo jacket and dark trousers, flanked by two bridesmaids in gowns holding floral arrangements and a groomsman. The image exhibits a soft focus and slight blur characteristic of amateur postwar photography.
